item.title: How Many Deck Boards Fit Across My Deck? Boards and Gap by Deck Width
item.description: How many 5.5 in deck boards fit across a deck 8 to 20 ft wide with a 1/8 in gap, and what the real gap works out to. Use the free deck board spacing calculator for your own boards.

item.title: How Many Deck Boards Do I Need? Deck Board Chart
item.description: Deck board counts for common deck sizes using 5.5 in boards with 1/8 in gaps, plus linear feet with 10% extra. Use the free deck board calculator for your own deck size, board width and gap.

item.title: How Many Bags of Concrete for Deck Footings? (12 x 36 in)
item.description: See how many 80 lb bags of concrete you need for 4 to 15 round deck footings, 12 inches wide and 36 inches deep, with 10% extra. Use the free deck footing calculator for your own hole size and frost depth.
